'''Tom Plis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Wizard World King of Corellia]] on 18 August 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB matching pilots]], according to Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2867">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-geoff-is-the-king-of-correllia-hehd2867/ geoff-is-the-king-of-correllia-heh], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 19 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-geoff-is-the-king-of-correllia-hehd2867/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] name Tom Plis (1 original concept credit).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Block 3]], dated 2009 on this wiki.
